requirements.text: The ideal candidate has experience applying modern AI technologies to solve real-world problems, including the use of generative AI, machine learning, agent-based systems, or data-driven automation. Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and software delivery processes is highly desirable. A strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, secure software development practices, vulnerability management, application security, and compliance requirements is also important.
